title: Owen Karmel
text:
Hello!
I’m Owen. I’m a Senior at Cornell University studying physics and biology. I’m enthusiastic about biotechnology, mathematics, ML, and mentorship. I want to pursue a PhD! Please see my CV.
I work as an undergraduate researcher in the Jiang Lab, where I’ve focused on RNA therapeutics. I’ve worked on two projects, regulated self amplifying RNA and miRNA sponges for aging.  I’ve also:

Mentored other undergrads in my lab and through CURB on email writing, interviews, and basic wet lab techniques.
Interned at Regeneron Pharmeceuticals and am currently interning at Thymmune Therapeutics.
Organized several speaker events with biotech CEOs.

In my spare time I love to read sci-fi, run, and organize camping trips with friends!
